confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and draft beer anchors use current citywide typical prices. Cocktail prices vary across Puebla menus; the anchor is a bounded midpoint. The city index reports retail wine bottles rather than restaurant glasses, so the wine glass estimate uses a local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Puebla is a mid-sized historic city in central Mexico. Food and drink anchors use Puebla-specific prices; accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of value-oriented historic Mexican city stays.
